::: {#exr-bat-meet-mattress}
The rate *80 Cal per mile* is, like all other rates, a quantity. All quantities have a {{< var dim.dim >}}. 
The {{< var dim.dim >}} 
of *80 Cal/mile* is [energy] / L, that is, {{< var dim.force >}}. 
[Remember that "[energy]" is pronounced, "the {{< var dim.dim >}} 
of energy.]{.column-margin} In this case, the {{< var dim.dim >}} of the *rate* is different from the {{< var dim.dim >}}s of either of the quantities that formed the rate. POINT OUT THAT THIS IS A FORCE and observe that a force is a good way to describe the difficulty of walking.
:::
 <!-- end of exr-bat-meet-mattress -->
